articles.title: Tether says it completed long-promised 'Big Four' audit of finances behind $180 billion USDT stablecoin
articles.snippet: KPMG U.S. examined Tether's books and even counted its gold bars as the $180 billion USDT issuer said it completed its long-promised financial audit.

articles.title: Forecasts for $1 million bitcoin price likely look too ambitious, key ratio suggests
articles.snippet: The thesis is that high yields on long-term U.S. Treasuries make non-yielding assets like bitcoin less attractive.

articles.title: Trezor warns 14,000 customers after fulfilment partner suffers data breach
articles.snippet: The incident marks the first time Trezor customers' shipping addresses were exposed.

articles.title: B2C2 taps Schroders veteran to chase Asia’s growing crypto wealth
articles.snippet: The institutional crypto liquidity provider is bringing on the former Schroders Wealth Management Asia chairman as it targets family offices and asset managers across the region.

articles.title: Kalshi in talks with Sequoia, Wellington for $750 million fund raise at $40 billion valuation
articles.snippet: The prediction-market platform raised $1 billion at a $22 billion valuation in May and is now discussing a new round that could nearly double that figure.
